surfaceIdsNote: The closed surface vocabulary of the whole orchestration family, identical to SPEC-057's surface-capability-matrix.json (surfaceIds). The checker rejects any other spelling, including the singular forms of earlier drafts.
status: draft; documentation reading as of 2026-10-24; no host observation recorded; not an adoption; no cell is enforced or protected

hostVersionsRead.note: A cell is host-observed only when it names a receipt created by a probe that the founder authorized.
hostVersionsRead.minHostVersionBasis: Reconciled with SPEC-057's matrix, whose versionBasis names the first public changelog entry per capability: agent teams 2.1.32, /batch 2.1.63, agent view and claude agents --json 2.1.145, dynamic workflows 2.1.154. A cell here states the first entry of its surface; the companion cell for agent-teams states 2.1.84 because it names the TaskCreated hook (changelog 2.1.84). The version at which hooks run inside subagents of each surface is not established. These are documentation readings, not support claims for any version and not host observations.

cells.capability: PreToolUse decision for Write and Edit by agent_id and path; audit, warn, block; Whisper context (warn and block); liveness canary; TaskCreated footprint check (exit status 2 in block)
cells.notes: Hooks run inside subagents with agent_id (documented for subagents); firing for this surface stays inferred until HV-6. Bash, MCP effects and unattributed writers are not covered. Hooks fail open and can be disabled. In-process teammates carry agent_id (documented, not observed; qualified by host version and HV-6); split-pane teammates are separate processes whose plugin loading is inferred. TaskCreated fires only when the task tools are present (documented rule); their presence on the model in use is unconfirmed (HV-7, GP-4); otherwise guard-not-covered for task creation. TaskCreated has no ask: an undecidable footprint is no-opinion with would-ask, and the unmarked-task behavior is unconfirmed (HV-7).
